rationale: Safe, hedged and non-repetitive, with sensible unplug advice and a reasonable timing question, and it correctly listed sump/pump/float as the candidate causes. However it never asked for the model number and wrongly assumed the pump sump needed the dryer moved ('they are not sensible to tackle while it is stacked'), so it skipped the front-accessible sump compartment clean that the ground truth shows the customer could do and which would have improved the fault. Escalation to an engineer is acceptable in the end, but it came prematurely after only three exchanges and without exploring the musty smell, softener use or drain-hose workaround, leaving the homeowner with a repair bill they might have avoided or at least better informed.
